title: Classic British Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting beef stew with tender meat and rich flavors, perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: 1 tsp dried thyme
ingredients.notes: fresh thyme leaves can be substituted

instructions: 1. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add onions and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. Add carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add beef broth, wine (if using), tomato paste, and thyme.
6. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
7. Braise for 2-1/2 to 3 hours, or until meat is tender.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.
